eps.d: Dibley is a perfect village somewhere in England, full of some of the strangest people. They've always been happy with their aged vicar, Reverend Pottle, but suddenly he dies. But none of the villagers are quite ready forthe new vicar when she does turn up.
Songs of Praise is coming to film in Dibley and its new woman vicar. Unfortunately, Dibley hasn't actually got a choir - a bit of a drawback in a programme full of hymns.
It's time for the autumn fayre, and Vicar Geraldine sets out to quadruple last year's tiny takings by finding huge star to open it.

After an unfortunate accident with a big tree in the greatest storm since the great storm, St Bamabus' church finds itself in need of a new stained glass window. The problem is, no one can remember what was in the old window.

It's time for the local elections and David is as confident as ever of total victory. He plans to twin-town Dibley with every single country in Europe except, of course, for Belgium. But he hasn't accounted for Geraldine. She may prove a formidable opponent.
Geraldine has a radical idea for an off-beat Sunday service and parish council chairman David is far from impressed.
Geraldine encourages Alice and Hugo to further their relationship and receives an unexpected proposal herself.
Radio Dibley goes on air. Geraldine presents the brain of Dibley and there's an astonishing on-air revelation.
Geraldine achieves fame through an appearance on Radio 2's Pause for Thought, but at what cost? Meanwhile the villagers prepare to launch the Dibley gala upon an unsuspecting public.
Busy preparing for Alice and Hugo's wedding, Geraldine is unprepared for her first meeting with David's dashing brother.
David's brother Simon returns to Dibley. But is he back to light up Geraldine's life - or break her heart?
Alice solves the problem of the Christmas show by proposing that she and Hugo play Mary and Joseph in a Nativity play.
The Bishop of Mulberry is to christen Alice and Hugo's baby, and David is amazed to find that he is in agreement with Geraldine.
A scorchingly hot summer leads to a severe water shortage in Dibley. When the water company announces plans to put a reservoir in the village, Geraldine decides it's time to take drastic action.
